title: Barbell Bicep Curl
description: The king of bicep exercises for building mass.
techniqueSteps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the barbell with an underhand grip.
Curl the bar toward your shoulders, keeping elbows tucked.
Slowly lower back to the starting position.

title: Skull Crushers
description: Isolated tricep movement for long-head development.
techniqueSteps: Lie on a bench holding an EZ-bar above your chest.
Lower the bar toward your forehead by bending only elbows.
Extend arms back to the starting position.
Keep your upper arms stationary.

title: Dumbbell Hammer Curls
description: Targets the brachialis and forearm.
techniqueSteps: Hold dumbbells with palms facing each other.
Curl the weight up while maintaining a neutral grip.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly.

title: Dips
description: Effective for triceps and lower chest.
techniqueSteps: Lower your body until elbows are at 90 degrees.
Push back up using triceps.
Avoid leaning too far forward to focus on triceps.
Keep shoulders stable.

title: Preacher Curls
description: Isolates the biceps by preventing momentum.
techniqueSteps: Sit on a preacher bench and rest your arms on the pad.
Hold an EZ-bar or dumbbells with an underhand grip.
Slowly lower the weight until arms are fully extended.
Curl the weight back up, squeezing the biceps at the top.

title: Wide-Grip Pull-Ups
description: Essential compound move for a V-taper back.
techniqueSteps: Grip the bar wider than shoulder-width.
Pull your chest toward the bar by driving elbows down.
Pause at the top, then slowly descend.
Avoid using momentum or swinging.

title: Bent Over Barbell Row
description: Builds back thickness and strength.
techniqueSteps: Hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Pull the bar to your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower the bar under control.

title: Lat Pulldowns
description: Machine alternative to pull-ups.
techniqueSteps: Pull the bar down to your upper chest.
Focus on driving your elbows back.
Keep your chest up and back slightly arched.
Return the bar slowly.

title: Seated Cable Row
description: Great for middle back development.
techniqueSteps: Sit at the machine with feet on the platforms and knees slightly bent.
Grip the handle and pull it towards your abdomen.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the peak.
Slowly extend your arms back to the starting position.

title: Hanging Knee Raises
description: Highly effective for targeting the lower abs.
techniqueSteps: Hang from a pull-up bar with a straight back.
Raise your knees toward your chest using your core.
Slowly lower your legs without swinging.
Keep your shoulders engaged throughout.

title: Plank with Shoulder Taps
description: Builds anti-rotational core strength.
techniqueSteps: Start in a high plank position.
Tap your left shoulder with your right hand.
Keep your hips perfectly still.
Repeat on the other side.

title: Russian Twists
description: Focuses on the obliques and rotation.
techniqueSteps: Sit with knees bent, feet slightly off the ground.
Twist your torso to the right, then to the left.
Move with control, not speed.
Keep your core tight.

title: Bicycle Crunches
description: The all-in-one abdominal movement.
techniqueSteps: Bring opposite elbow to opposite knee.
Straighten the other leg out.
Rotate through your core, not just arms.
Keep your neck relaxed.

title: Leg Raises
description: Targets the lower abs and hip flexors.
techniqueSteps: Lie on your back with hands under your glutes or by your sides.
Keep your legs straight and lift them until they are vertical.
Slowly lower your legs back down without touching the floor.
Keep your lower back pressed against the ground.

title: Barbell Back Squat
description: The fundamental lower body exercise.
techniqueSteps: Rest the bar on your upper traps.
Squat down by pushing hips back and knees out.
Keep your back straight and chest up.
Drive back up through your heels.

title: Romanian Deadlift
description: Targets the hamstrings and glutes.
techniqueSteps: Hold the bar at hip level.
Lower the bar by pushing hips back with a slight knee bend.
Keep the bar close to your shins.
Return to start by engaging hamstrings.

title: Lunges
description: Great for balance and leg isolation.
techniqueSteps: Step forward with one leg.
Lower hips until both knees are bent at 90 degrees.
Push back up to the start.
Keep your torso upright.

title: Leg Press
description: Machine-based leg builder.
techniqueSteps: Lower the platform until knees are near chest.
Do not lock your knees at the top.
Keep feet flat on the platform.
Engage your quads.

title: Leg Extensions
description: Isolation exercise for the quadriceps.
techniqueSteps: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad.
Place your ankles under the roller pads.
Extend your legs until they are straight.
Slowly lower the weight back to the starting position.

title: Hamstring Curls
description: Isolation exercise for the back of the legs.
techniqueSteps: Lie face down on the machine or sit (depending on the type).
Place the roller pad against your lower calves.
Curl your legs up as far as possible.
Slowly return to the starting position.
